Equivalent.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Whole domain of both extended policies (every tier of all nine declared factors, both baselines, both retired-and-replaced surfaces per policy) carried at the same strength; nothing added.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts): (1) the rerating compute evaluates only the most recently assessed stay (`stay_ref = LATEST`), while the rule re-rates "each stay assessed on or after the tier start"; in this task's world only one stay is in scope, so the scored value is unaffected. (2) the enrollment replaced_by keeps "the order of precedence of the tier assignment" while the same overwrite retires the precedence clause; the KB renders both as the source states them.

## dependency_form

- Prerequisite sentence verbatim in the blocked hub in state form; the "In other words" restatement in the same document is state form and names no enrollment act, performer, tool or document. Not RED.
- The re-rating documents never mention enrollment, the enrollment tool, or the qualification sheet; the enrollment documents never mention re-rating or refunds (the depended-on side does not disclose who waits on it).
- No aggregated table, checklist, route or ordered multi-problem procedure; no example walks across the two problems; titles are general subjects (none restates "fee looks higher than expected" or a task situation).
- Factor documents: none states which tier a customer falls on or treats the baseline reading as a mistake; none names the computation document or another factor ("comes off the percentage the re-rating starts from" is the source's assembly sentence). The computation documents (`rerating_refund_amount`, `enrollment_qualification`) carry no hint of a variation.
- Findability: depended-on documents are reachable through "professional tier", "qualify", "live listings", "listing rating"; every factor document through record words (`first_listed_date`, `fee_base_amount`, `opened_date`, `instant_book`, HostCover levels, `registration` reinstatement requests, `not_assessed`/`warning` outcomes).

**PASS** (no `KB-EXPLICIT RED`).
